ctx.x: I think it was the anniversary of Billy Strayhorn’s death. The church was packed. Adams was with me then. This was the old church. Not the new one there now, in the complex. Not the new one. It was the old St. Peter’s Church on Lexington. Duke Ellington and his doctor – Dr. Logan was a very tall man. We went into that negro national anthem, as it was called, and the first ones to stand up in the church was Duke Ellington and Dr. Logan. Then the whole entire congregation stood up.
